title: SKF_ANALYZE_RESULT_JSON envelope (v1)
description: Single-line JSON document skf-analyze-source prints, prefixed with the literal 'SKF_ANALYZE_RESULT_JSON: ': on stdout when a run ends (briefs written, zero units confirmed, a coexistence redirect or skip), and on stderr at every HARD HALT of a headless run. The shared emitter builds each line from the payload a step stages, so pipelines branch on status, halt_reason and unit_counts without parsing the human-readable report. src/skf-analyze-source/references/headless-contract.md describes each field.

skf-envelope.description: The shared emitter's settings for this workflow, read by skf-emit-result-envelope.py: the workflow, the line's prefix, the status a halt carries, the exit code of each halt_reason and the result file stem. Nothing in the schema references this entry, so it constrains no envelope.

status.description: 'success' when a run ends with its briefs written, or with none because no unit was confirmed. 'redirect' when the auto coexistence gate routes the target to an update of an existing skill ([M]erge). 'skipped' when it skips the target ([S]kip). 'error' at every HARD HALT.

report_path.description: Absolute path of the analysis report. Null on a redirect, a skip and a HALT before the report was written.

brief_paths.description: Absolute path of every skill-brief.yaml the run wrote. A brief is written only after it passed the brief writer and, outside the docs-only branch, the schema gate. Empty when no unit was confirmed, when the user chose not to write the briefs, and on a redirect, a skip and a HALT.

confirmed.description: Units approved for a brief (step 5, or the units step 1a confirmed).

skipped.description: Units rejected in step 5, or 1 for the target a coexistence [S]kip passed over.

unit_counts.description: The unit counts. A run that confirms no unit reports confirmed 0, which the forger's AN circuit breaker reads as no skillable unit.

exit_code.description: Process exit code, derived from halt_reason: null gives 0 (success, redirect and skipped), input-missing 2, resolution-failure and pin-invalid 3, write-failed 4, user-cancelled 6.

halt_reason.description: Null unless the run halted. One of the documented HALT classes on error; write-failed also covers a brief the writer or the schema gate rejects.

mode.description: 'auto' when the invocation carries [auto], from activation through step 1a and its docs-only branch; 'interactive' otherwise, also in the step-by-step chain an [auto] run falls back to when shape detection cannot classify the repository.

result_path.description: The per-run result file the emitter wrote, {forge_data_folder}/analyze-source-result-<YYYYMMDD-HHmmss>.json (UTC), beside its analyze-source-result-latest.json copy. Stamped by the emitter, never typed. Null for a HALT, which writes no result file, and when the write failed (warnings say why).

phase.description: The step and section that halted, such as 'step-auto-scope:8'.

path.description: The file or folder the failed operation targeted, when the halt names one.

error.description: Optional. On a HALT, the step that halted and its message; absent when the run ended.

coexistence.description: Optional, auto mode only: the coexistence decision of step 1a section 0c when a skill already matched the target ('alongside' writes a -wiki skill beside it).

pinned_ref.description: Optional, auto mode only: the git ref the run pinned (the --pin value, or the latest release tag). Absent when no pin resolved.

pinned_version.description: Optional, auto mode only: the version of pinned_ref. Absent when no pin resolved, and for a pin with no version (a branch, or a latest release whose tag is not a version).

source_type.description: Optional: 'docs-only' when the target was a documentation URL, so brief-skill skips repo-based enrichment.

redirect_to.description: Optional, on a redirect only: the workflow the forger routes to (update-skill).

skill_name.description: Optional, on a redirect only: the existing skill to update.

skill_path.description: Optional, on a redirect only: the existing skill's active version folder.

skipped_reason.description: Optional, on a skip only: why the target was skipped.

gate.description: The decision the run took with no one to ask. Step 1a: section 3b's merge-or-split decision for a monorepo, section 4's choice between an app and a library when the only app signal is a framework dependency, and section 5's choice of the documented language when the language helper found more than one. A headless run of the step-by-step chain: the default of each step's gate (continue past the scan, accept the unit classifications, accept every composite merge, confirm every recommendation and flag every stack skill candidate, write the briefs).

default_action.description: The documented default: 'merge' for the cohesion check, 'reference-app' for the app-or-library choice, the helper's first language for the language choice, the menu option a step-by-step gate takes ('C', or 'Y' to write the briefs).

taken_action.description: What the run decided: 'merge' or 'split', 'reference-app' or 'library-API', the language the brief records, or the option a headless gate took.

reason.description: One line on why, such as the cohesion trigger that held.

evidence.description: Optional decision data: the package count and the members, the languages the helper listed, or what a step-by-step gate accepted (the composites, the confirmed units, the briefs).

headless_decisions.description: Optional. Each auto-decision the run recorded in its sink the moment it decided, so a halt still reports the decisions taken before it. Present only when there is at least one.

warnings.description: Optional. Non-fatal anomalies the run recorded in its sink or the emitter raised, one string each (for example result_file_write_failed). Present only when there is at least one.
